• The "Holiday-Segar Method" (often spelled "Holliday-Segar Method") is a commonly used method to calculate daily fluid maintenance requirements for children based on their weight.
  • The method works as follows:

For the first 10 kg of body weight: 100 mL/kg

For the next 10 kg of body weight: 50 mL/kg

For any weight above 20 kg: 20 mL/kg

For a 20 kg child:

The first 10 kg = 10 kg x 100 mL/kg = 1000 mL

The next 10 kg = 10 kg x 50 mL/kg = 500 mL

Total fluid requirement:

1000 mL + 500 mL = 1500 mL

This means, according to the Holliday-Segar method, a 20 kg child would require 1500 mL of fluid per day.
